startup_status.details: Application built with 'uv sync' and started with 'uv run python main.py' under SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy. Process ran continuously for ~75 seconds of monitoring without crashing and was terminated cleanly via taskkill at the end of the analysis window.

execution_trace.action: Ran 'uv sync' to install dependencies (pygame 2.6.1, CPython 3.12).
Launched 'uv run python main.py' as a background process with stdout/stderr redirected to log files.
Pygame initialized; Game() instantiated and run() entered the main loop.
Main game loop ran continuously for ~75 seconds with no stdout output and no stderr exceptions.
Process terminated via taskkill /F as required by the unattended analysis protocol; verified no leftover game process remained.
